description: QZ Tray certificate and private key used to sign print requests, so receipts print without the QZ Allow prompt.

fields.label: Setup
fields.options: Upload the QZ Tray certificate (digital-certificate.txt) and its private key (private-key.pem) as Private files. The private key never leaves the server; it is only used to sign print requests. Then import the same certificate into QZ Tray (Site Manager) on every printing PC.

fields.label: QZ Certificate
fields.description: digital-certificate.txt (PEM). Shared with QZ Tray on each printing PC.

fields.label: QZ Private Key
fields.description: private-key.pem. Upload as a Private file; never shared with browsers.

name: URY QZ Settings
